title: MCP Conformance Engineering: Versioning, Evidence, and Operations

questions.question: Why is one successful SDK tools/list call insufficient conformance evidence?
options: The normalized value may hide wire fields, version behavior, proxy changes, and invalid responses
SDKs cannot call MCP tools
A successful call always selects the legacy era
Conformance applies only to Registry publishers
questions.explanation: Conformance must inspect the raw request and response, selected version era, intermediaries, and SDK transformation.

questions.question: A modern probe returns JSON-RPC error -32021. What should a fallback-capable client do?
options: Immediately send initialize for the legacy era
Treat the peer as offline
Keep the modern era and correct or report the missing capability declaration
Ignore the error and retry without capabilities
questions.explanation: A recognized modern error proves modern behavior. It is correction evidence, not permission to downgrade.

questions.question: How should a modern client handle a result with resultType complete and an unfamiliar additive field?
options: Change resultType to input_required
Reject every result containing an unknown key
Accept the known result type and preserve or deliberately ignore the additive field according to its role
Treat the unfamiliar field as a legacy handshake
questions.explanation: Additive fields support forward compatibility. They are different from an unknown lifecycle discriminator.

questions.question: What is the required JSON-RPC response to a notification with no id?
options: A server/discover result
No JSON-RPC response
A complete result with null content
An error with id null
questions.explanation: Notifications are one-way. The final transport serializer must not emit a JSON-RPC success or error.

questions.question: Which evidence best proves that a proxy preserved an origin protocol error?
options: Redacted ingress, origin, and egress status and body evidence with stable digests
A screenshot of the gateway dashboard
The SDK exception class alone
The proxy process uptime
questions.explanation: Three-boundary evidence reveals status collapse, body rewriting, and the exact hop where behavior changed.

questions.question: A candidate fails its negative transcripts and the previous version has no admission or health evidence. What should the release gate do?
options: Select the newest Registry version
Promote because golden transcripts passed
Roll back to the package tagged latest
Hold the release until an eligible rollback target or a corrected candidate is proven
questions.explanation: A rollback without exact admission and health evidence is another unverified release, so the safe action is to hold.
